features.title: Orchestrator with events and error isolation

features.title: Deterministic scoring and confidence level
features.notes: Deterministic; fallback data never yields High.

features.title: Optional free LLM layer with template fallback
features.notes: Gemini free tier via OpenAI-compatible endpoint (gemini-3.5-flash-lite). Wording only; number guard; template fallback. Tested with mocked fetch only: no Gemini key is set, so no real LLM call has been made.

features.title: Run API with streaming events
features.notes: POST /api/run streams NDJSON events then the result; ?stream=0 for plain JSON; validation, body limit, per-client rate limit; GET /api/run/[id], GET /api/meta.
